back_translation: On the twelfth day of the tenth month, in the tenth year, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
Say, the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I am against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your rivers, who says, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it myself.’

But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams cling to your scales. I will haul you up out of the midst of your rivers, with all the fish of your streams clinging to your scales.

I will leave you in the wilderness, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field; you will not be gathered or buried. I have given you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the air.
Then all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they were only a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
When Israel grasped you with their hand, you splintered and tore all their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke and made their backs give way.
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I will bring a sword against you and cut off from you man and beast.
The land of Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD, because Pharaoh said, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it myself.’
Therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate wasteland, from Migdol to Syene, as far as the border of Cush.
No foot of man or beast will pass through it, and it will be uninhabited for forty years.

I will make the land of Egypt a desolation among desolate lands, and her cities will lie desolate among ruined cities for forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.
For the Lord GOD says this: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations to which they were scattered.
I will restore Egypt from captivity and bring them back to the land of Pathros, the land of their origin; and there they will be a lowly kingdom.
Egypt will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations. I will make Egypt small, so that it will never again rule over the nations.
Egypt will no longer be an object of trust for the house of Israel, but will be a reminder of the iniquity of their turning to Egypt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
On the first day of the first month, in the twenty-seventh year, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

“Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army labor strenuously against Tyre, until every head was made bald and every shoulder rubbed raw; yet neither he nor his army received any wages from Tyre for the labor they performed against it.

Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he will carry off its wealth, seize its spoil, and plunder its goods, and that will be the wages for his army.
I have given him the land of Egypt as the reward for the labor he performed, because they did it for Me, declares the Lord GOD.
On that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth to speak among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
